1m.geometryConversion: Exact bitwise float32 vertex positions and original triangle order; shared vertices are indexed without changing coordinates, winding, scale or triangle count

700k.geometryConversion: Exact bitwise float32 vertex positions and original triangle order; shared vertices are indexed without changing coordinates, winding, scale or triangle count

400k.geometryConversion: Exact bitwise float32 vertex positions and original triangle order; shared vertices are indexed without changing coordinates, winding, scale or triangle count

coordinates.viewerFitMethod: Original model-space positions; normalization and centering only as GPU Model Root transform uniforms
coordinates.note: Bounds vary slightly due to externally supplied simplification; no axis change, origin offset, or scale transformation was applied during conversion. STL has no explicit unit metadata. Model-origin equivalence is judged geometrically.

quality.1m: Highest observed fine-surface continuity; cracks and depressions remain nuanced at close range
quality.700k: Good silhouette and prominent depressions, slightly more faceted on close inspection
quality.400k: Obvious large triangle facets when zoomed, unsuitable as primary conservation-viewing geometry
quality.comparison: Same VTK camera settings and flat lighting used for original STL comparison. testshots/dolmen-*.png and *-closeup.png

selection.fallback: No automatic 400k fallback; diagnostic URL override ?v16aModel=400k is available
selection.reason: Desktop prioritizes detail; Mobile reduces source GLB transfer from 36.64MB to 22.08MB while keeping acceptable visible geometry. Actual WebGL2 device performance is awaiting physical-browser verification
selection.lod: No continuous LOD or distance-based auto-switch

viewer.rotation: implemented; pointer-gesture logic tested with mocked GL
viewer.zoom: implemented; pointer/wheel/button logic tested with mocked GL
viewer.loadingProgress: XHR lengthComputable download progress; loaded-state transition tested with mocked GL
viewer.cameraFit: Oriented bounding-box perspective fit, preserved original vertex data
viewer.notes: Environment Chromium has WebGL/WebGL2 disabled; shader compilation, GPU rasterization, GPU timing and real touch-device performance cannot be certified by mocked-browser tests

regression.chapter04: source DOM, provisional data and skyOverlay.js unchanged; navigation tested in browser mock
regression.chapter07: source DOM and participation.js unchanged; navigation tested in browser mock
regression.navigation: core flow retained; Chapter 2 transitions tested

tests.software3DRender: passed 3/3 on actual STL using VTK offscreen, same camera and close-up
tests.mockDOMEvents: passed model load, drag-rotate, pinch zoom, pan/zoom/reset actions, three mode switches, Chapter 2 overview/detail navigation, Chapter 04/07 navigation, no page swipe during viewer gestures
tests.mockGLBFixture: 400k geometry served for frontend parsing tests across all 5 viewports; tests of simulated loader are not benchmarks of the selected 1m/700k models
tests.realWebGLBrowser: not run: environment GPU context creation rejected by Chromium
tests.realDeviceRecommendation: Open the site on desktop and mobile browsers with WebGL2 and verify rendering, surface quality, pinch, pan and frame rate before final release

v16b.note: Coordinate reference and model geometry are preserved. Complete physical-browser viewer acceptance before signing off the release.
